notes.title: Want to help fund Town Girls?
notes.content:
Hello early access peeps, we have a pretty important announcement to make today regarding funding for the game as we feel we can make it bigger and better with your help.

The way we were going to ask for funding was through our Patreon where you can get rewards for however much you pledge and your money would be put into making Town Girls and by extension any other games we make.

This would help us out greatly as sales for the game have been pretty lacklustre recently and we are humans who need to make ends meet. We're not saying you have to pledge and give us extra money because you already bought the game, but if you're feeling kind and want to help a small indie studio with their game creation, it will be very appreciated! ^^;

Here's the link to the Patreon: [url=https://patreon.com/belliescolourcorner]Bellies Colour Corner[/url]

We hope to see you there! Any issues, please do not hesitate to message us on either the Patreon (when you pledge) or the Discord (when you've been automatically joined to it).

Thank you for your support so far.
- WindowsLogic Productions

notes.title: A Little News
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we hope you're all doing well.

It's been a while since we released Sierra and in turn, our last update (0.3.5.0). We are however working on a massive update which will bump the game to 0.5.0.0, and adds two new characters, a MILF and her daughter. I can't leak much about this, but we can post some screen shots of what we've developed so far so you can get an idea about at least one of the characters. :P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240570/37d20be27f3a7c3987001cf46d634d185b1a948a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240570/f43147517ab87aaf3c97b8d0c44d527c165eb235.jpg[/img]

This character is the MILF who works at the local strip club, she is a sheep. She gives men and woman different treatment based on what they pay, she doesn't discriminate and would probably even fuck a LGBTQ person if they paid high enough. Does this mean you can shag sheep in the game now? Possibly ;3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240570/9bc4cf1e17d3bd0c303f65c97895c5d5507d05b9.jpg[/img]

We have completed the MILF's date, we're just waiting on assets for the daughter sheep, this fifth character in the Town Girls saga will be an OnlyFans model on the in-universe website "SixthCensure" which is a play on words for "Sixth Sense" and "Grooming", we made this joke because on OnlyFans in our universe you act like a sugar daddy to girls on there by giving them copious amounts of money. The daughter has some very spicy pics to view on ClopPad as well, even moreso than the MILF sheep...

We also have some under-the-hood improvements for the game specially for 0.5.0.0 as well, one new feature that has come from this is the ability to choose what your real name is and additional information about [b]YOUR[/b] main character. We want [b]YOU[/b] to have the ability to make the game completely [b]YOURS[/b] and to write about your character (within 36 or less characters). This ability will appear in your stats page and will be used during the endgame of Town Girls where [strike]the girls gossip about you[/strike]. Oops, spoilers!

Finally, if you really enjoy this game that we've created and think it's a quality product, share it with people who might be interested in this type of game. [b]Feel free to discuss this news with us below and we'll try to reply to any query you may have.[/b]

That's all from us for now, thank you!
- WindowsLogic Productions.
